Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Shaybah oilfield, Aramco Yanbu site and Riyadh and Abha airports
events.summary: Yemen's Houthis said they attacked Saudi energy, airport and military targets including the Shaybah oilfield, an Aramco site in Yanbu, King Khalid airport in Riyadh and Abha airport; Saudi damage was not confirmed in the report.

events.title: China Q3 GDP grows 4.5%, beating forecasts; September retail sales up 1.1%
events.summary: China's GDP grew 4.5% y/y in Q3 (poll 4.4%, Q2 4.3%) and 1.2% q/q; September retail sales rose 1.1% (poll 0.5%) and industrial output 5.5%, while Jan-Sep fixed-asset investment fell 7.2% and property investment 20.6%.

events.title: China aluminium output hits record quarterly high despite capacity cap
events.summary: China's primary aluminium output reached a record quarterly high in Q3 2026 despite the 45 million tonne capacity ceiling, after August set a monthly record of 3.98 million tonnes.

events.title: IRGC says a second supertanker hit a naval mine in Hormuz and declares the strait closed
events.summary: Iran's IRGC said a second supertanker struck a naval mine on an unauthorized Strait of Hormuz route and declared the strait closed after the tanker hits; the vessels were not identified and the US says the strait is under US and partner control. The claims are unverified.

events.title: Copper falls as LME stocks rise and mine supply concerns ease
events.summary: LME copper fell on Monday as exchange inventories edged higher and concerns over mine supply eased.

events.title: NBC: attacks on ships around the Strait of Hormuz reach record highs as Iran steps up strikes
events.summary: NBC News reported attacks on vessels around Hormuz have reached record levels with little US response; Reuters-cited tracking had already counted at least 12 tanker attacks in the week to Oct 5, the most since the war began.

events.title: South Korea's LS MnM considers cutting copper processing capacity
events.summary: LS MnM, South Korea's biggest copper smelter (about 600,000 t/yr of refined copper), is considering a cut to its copper processing capacity as smelter margins stay squeezed by very low treatment charges.

events.title: UKMTO: tanker hit by unidentified projectile northeast of Saudi Arabia's Jubail
events.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile northeast of Jubail on Friday; the crew was safe and evacuated. It extends Gulf shipping attacks beyond the Strait of Hormuz into Saudi waters.

events.title: Trump waives some Russia sanctions, restrictions and energy-linked duties under the Graham Act
events.summary: Trump signed an executive order waiving application of certain sanctions, restrictions and duties under the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (signed Sept 18, initial measures due Oct 18) and certified to Congress that the waivers serve US national interests; Bloomberg says the waivers cover Russia energy tariffs.

events.title: South32 maintains FY27 guidance after September-quarter copper output surge
events.summary: South32's September 2026 quarterly report showed a surge in copper output and the miner kept its FY27 production guidance unchanged.

events.title: IRGC says a supertanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine on an 'unauthorized' Hormuz route
events.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said an oil tanker ignited after striking a naval mine while using what they called an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz; the vessel was not identified and the claim was not independently verified. It follows similar IRGC claims on Oct 10 (supertanker) and Oct 14 (container ship).

events.title: Indian official says crude tanker targeted by missile in Strait of Hormuz
events.summary: An Indian shipping official said a crude oil tanker was targeted by a missile in the Strait of Hormuz on Friday and also referred to the recent Romania-linked tanker incident; it adds to this week's string of attacks on Gulf shipping.

events.title: Tasnim: Yemeni drone attacks on Dammam halt airport activity
events.summary: Iran's Tasnim News reported Yemeni drone attacks on Dammam in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province and said activity at Dammam airport was halted; not independently confirmed.

events.title: Iran says US forces attacked Konark naval base; US official calls claim inaccurate
events.summary: Iran's navy said US forces attacked the Konark naval base in the morning, firing at a 35 mm cannon; a US official told CNN the claim was inaccurate.

events.title: Copper falls for a third day as hot US CPI hits metals; ICSG sees refined surplus widening in 2027
events.summary: Copper fell for a third straight session after strong US inflation data lifted rate-hike bets, and the ICSG, meeting in Lisbon this week, said it expects the global refined copper surplus to widen in 2027.

events.title: Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia, setting St Petersburg oil terminal and depot ablaze
events.summary: Russia's defence ministry said it downed about 1,015 Ukrainian drones overnight, one of the largest attacks of the war; fires hit the St Petersburg oil terminal, the Ruchyi oil depot and a VK data centre, with one person killed. Russia answered with about 300 drones.

events.title: Iranian supreme leader's adviser calls claims that Hormuz is open 'baseless'
events.summary: An adviser to Iran's supreme leader told Tasnim the claim that the Strait of Hormuz is open is baseless.

events.title: Saudi Arabia to postpone in-person 'Davos in the Desert' after Houthi attacks
events.summary: The FT reported Saudi Arabia will postpone the in-person Future Investment Initiative after Houthi attacks; Fars separately reported sirens and an explosion in Riyadh the same hour.

events.title: Tehran seeks to punish Trump in the midterms with oil price pain, Iranian officials say
events.summary: The Washington Post reported that Iranian officials said Tehran aims to keep oil prices high ahead of the US midterm elections.

events.title: Iran deploys new tactics against ships; two vessels struck in Strait of Hormuz
events.summary: Brent rose to about $106.32 early on 14 Oct after two vessels were hit. Kpler: only 2.9m barrels moved through Hormuz on 11 Oct vs 17.1m b/d pre-war.

web.title: Ramkrishna Forgings - News
web.takeaway: Ramkrishna Forgings traded at Rs 700.85 on September 4, 2026, at a P/E of about 119.

web.title: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd (NSE)
web.takeaway: The company's next earnings report is due on October 28, 2026.

episodes.lesson: Energy-rich producers can become war targets.
A major exporter at war moves energy, food and metals at once.
Sanctioning one big producer acts like a mine closure.
m: LME up about 30% in under two weeks to a seven-year high
